details.description: API tokens and internal secrets are hardcoded in source control (PAYMENT_TOKEN, MAIL_SERVER_KEY, INTERNAL_AUTH).
details.fix_explanation: Move all secrets to environment variables and fail or warn if missing. This prevents secrets from landing in version control and allows secure injection at deployment time.
details.secure_code_snippet:
PAYMENT_TOKEN = os.getenv("PAYMENT_TOKEN", "")
MAIL_SERVER_KEY = os.getenv("MAIL_SERVER_KEY", "")
INTERNAL_AUTH_KEY = os.getenv("INTERNAL_AUTH_KEY", "")

details.description: The code constructs an auth token using MD5 which is cryptographically broken and unsuitable for HMAC/secrets.
details.fix_explanation: Use HMAC with SHA-256 (or a stronger KDF) with a secret key from the environment to generate tokens. Reject generation when the key is absent.
details.secure_code_snippet: mac = hmac.new(INTERNAL_AUTH_KEY.encode(), username.encode(), hashlib.sha256); return mac.hexdigest()

details.description: SQL query is created with string formatting including user-controlled 'uid' which enables SQL injection.
details.fix_explanation: Use parameterized queries and validate types. Reject non-numeric ids if the schema expects integer ids.
details.secure_code_snippet: c.execute("SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?", (uid,))

details.description: User-supplied 'name' is inserted into a shell command (zip) executed with shell=True, allowing command injection.
details.fix_explanation: Avoid invoking shell utilities with untrusted input. Use the Python zipfile module and reject invalid export names (no path separators).
details.secure_code_snippet: with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'w') as zf: zf.write(DB_FILE, arcname=os.path.basename(DB_FILE))

details.vulnerability_type: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) and no timeout
details.description: User-controlled notify_url is directly posted to without validation or timeout, enabling SSRF and long blocking requests.
details.fix_explanation: Validate notify_url against an allow-list of domains and require HTTPS; add a reasonable requests timeout and handle errors safely.
details.secure_code_snippet: if not _is_allowed_notify_url(url): raise ValueError('notify_url invalid'); requests.post(url, json=..., timeout=5)

details.description: update_records opens arbitrary filesystem paths passed from the API, allowing an attacker to read sensitive files.
details.fix_explanation: Restrict config access to a controlled directory (CONFIG_DIR) and only accept base filenames; verify final path is inside CONFIG_DIR.
details.secure_code_snippet: file_path = os.path.join(CONFIG_DIR, basename); if not file_path.startswith(os.path.abspath(CONFIG_DIR)): raise ValueError(...)

details.vulnerability_type: Missing authentication and debug mode enabled
details.description: Critical endpoints (transfer, config, export) are unprotected and the app runs with debug=True which can leak secrets and allow code execution.
details.fix_explanation: Require an admin API key on protected endpoints and ensure debug mode is disabled by default (controlled via environment variable).
